source: I… I’ve had enough…
translation: 我……我受够了……

source: Our journey with Camp Buddy has gone as far as it could…
translation: 我们与 Camp Buddy 的旅程已经走到了尽头……

source: And honestly... It’s something I don’t aspire for anymore…
translation: 而且说实话……我已经不再追求这个了……

source: I’ve been holding on to this place for so long, sacrificing myself for the camp and everyone else this whole time, but never really pursued my own happiness…
translation: 我坚持这个地方太久了，一直为营地和其他所有人牺牲自己，却从没有真正追求过自己的幸福……

source: I want us to leave the camp…
translation: 我想让我们离开营地……

source: There’s no reason why we can’t be together and still stay at the camp!
translation: 没有理由说我们不能在一起，同时留在营地！

source: But it’s not just about the camp, Yoshinori…! I thought you’d understand…
translation: 但这不只是关于营地，Yoshinori……！我以为你会理解……

source: How can I understand?! It’s one thing to turn away from a huge opportunity, but now you even want us just to leave everything behind?!
translation: 我怎么理解？！拒绝一个巨大机会是一回事，但现在你甚至想让我们抛下一切离开？！

source: Is that place really your only dream?! Is that the only thing that’ll make you happy?!
translation: 那个地方真的是你唯一的梦想吗？！那是唯一能让你幸福的东西吗？！

source: I thought it’s what we’ve been fighting for this entire time…!
translation: 我以为这就是我们一直以来为之奋斗的东西……！

source: Why are you giving up all of a sudden? That would make everything we’ve been through pointless!
translation: 你为什么突然放弃？那会让我们经历的一切都毫无意义！

source: We… don’t share the same views anymore…
translation: 我们……不再拥有相同的想法了……

source: This was a mistake all along… We can’t spend our futures together…
translation: 这一切从一开始就是个错误……我们无法一起度过未来……

source: Being partners was never meant for us…
translation: 我们从来都不该成为伴侣……

source: Y-You’re letting go of me too…?
translation: 你、你也要放弃我吗……？

source: It’s over.
translation: 结束了。

source: {i}I was at loss for words as Goro drove us both home in silence…{/i}
translation: {i}Goro 沉默地开车带我们回家时，我无话可说……{/i}

source: {i}I can’t believe that I never saw how he was losing heart for the camp… and for our relationship…{/i}
translation: {i}我不敢相信自己从未看出他正在对营地……以及对我们的关系失去信心……{/i}

source: Aren’t you coming in…?
translation: 你不进来吗……？

source: I need time… and space...
translation: 我需要时间……和空间……

source: I trust you with the camp.
translation: 我把营地托付给你。

source: You can’t leave just like this…
translation: 你不能就这样离开……

source: We can still talk this out. Don’t let everything end this way…
translation: 我们还可以谈清楚。别让一切以这种方式结束……
